pins.name: GPIO2
pins.notes: Must be HIGH at boot. Leave unconnected

pins.name: GPIO0
pins.notes: LOW at boot = flash mode. Leave HIGH for normal use

pins.name: RXD
pins.notes: UART: the part receives data here. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin

pins.name: TXD
pins.notes: UART: the part sends data here. Connect to an ESP32 RX pin (AT firmware: 115200 baud)

pins.name: CH_PD
pins.notes: Enable: must be HIGH. Tie to 3.3 V

pins.name: RST
pins.notes: Reset, active LOW. Leave unconnected or tie HIGH

pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: 3.3 V only. Draws up to about 170 mA when sending

sources.title: Espressif ESP8266EX datasheet
sources.section: Strapping pins GPIO0, GPIO2, GPIO15; supply 3.0 to 3.6 V; TX current up to 170 mA
